technique_name: Compose an opinionated essay arguing why the given topic should not be ignored.
description: Climate change is an urgent challenge that we cannot afford to ignore. The devastating effects of global warming are already impacting people and their livelihoods, with the potential of driving millions of species to extinction, if not addressed. The scientific consensus is that the main cause of climate change is human-made, caused by emitting large amounts of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. We have already allowed the temperature of the Earth to rise by 1.2 ºC since pre-industrial times
